title: docs/qa: platform-checklist scratch bodies (studio-authoring.json, records-forms.json) carry the action location words #36495 retires and will be refused by the save door
body:
repo:objectstack#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibyUSf2nKJWW6qBemSU

Filing gate: ① (b) out-of-scope finding, the contract review on PR #37929 (#36495), N7 in record 7227370865, relayed by L1-a in 7227400577. Source: fleet.
Blocked-by: #36495

## 维护者速读

- 问题：#36495 把动作位置的旧词（`list_toolbar`、`list_item`、`record_header`、`record_more`）收窄成新词以后，平台测试清单里有两份测试项，送进保存接口的样例正文还在用旧词，跑清单时这几步会被拒，看起来像平台坏了。
- 修法方向：把这些样例正文换成新词，并核对安装样例在 19 版下是否会被重放转换。
- 优先级 p2：#36495 合并后，跑这两份清单就会出现假失败。

## What happens (per the review at PR #37929's head 0ada6058; re-measure after it merges)

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/studio-authoring.json:5372` and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/records-forms.json:7273` send scratch bodies with the old words to the save door. At 19 the save door refuses those words.
- `records-forms.json:77`, the install-local recipe, carries no protocol floor. Whether it replays through the 19 conversion is not verified.
- The recorded builds `order_to_cash.json` and `travel_expense.json` declare `engines.protocol: ^19`, and the artifact door replays them through the major step, so they are not affected.

## Acceptance

- Every scratch body under `docs/qa/**` that reaches a door uses the new location words. The PR lists each one.
- The install-local recipe at `records-forms.json:77` is measured: either it replays through the conversion, or it is rewritten.
- `git grep` over `docs/qa/**` for the four retired words finds only prose that names them as retired.
